##### Project general facts

Najd One is a boutique townhouse development by Reportage Properties, comprising 24 four-bedroom townhouses offered across two layouts. Each townhouse rises across a ground floor, two upper floors, and a roof level. The design follows a modern Italian aesthetic, blending contemporary elegance with a refined, comfortable sense of luxury, positioning Najd One as a boutique residential address for discerning buyers.

The surrounding community offers a sports complex, an adjacent park and gym, and access to a mosque, cafés, restaurants, retail outlets and shopping centres. Additional lifestyle conveniences include entertainment venues, cinemas and lounges, landscaped green spaces, a supermarket, clinics, a bank, dedicated parking and bike racks.

Each townhouse includes private balconies and terraces sized to the unit plan, along with a maid's room and fully tiled bathrooms, including en-suite and guest facilities. Every bedroom has its own private bathroom, complemented by fitted kitchen cabinetry and countertops, vanity units with mirrors, and air conditioning throughout. A large private roof garden is included with each unit.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Qadisiyyah is a well-established residential district in the eastern part of Riyadh, offering a balanced lifestyle with a focus on comfort and everyday convenience. The area is known for its calm atmosphere, making it a preferred choice for families seeking a peaceful environment while remaining connected to the city’s main destinations.

The neighborhood features a mix of villas and low-rise residential buildings, along with essential amenities such as schools, mosques, supermarkets, and healthcare facilities. Local parks and open spaces add to the community feel, providing residents with areas for relaxation and outdoor activities.

Al Qadisiyyah benefits from convenient access to key roads and highways, allowing easy connectivity to central Riyadh and other major districts. Its strategic location, combined with ongoing development in the eastern part of the city, makes it an attractive option for both living and long-term investment.
